mapper.select: INSERT INTO tool_operation (tenant_id, run_id, tool_name, risk_level, state, idempotency_key, request_digest, tool_arguments, fencing_token) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{toolName}, #{riskLevel}::tool_risk_level, 'IN_FLIGHT', #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{toolArguments}::jsonb, #{fencingToken}) RETURNING operation_id::text
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_operation SET state = #{newState}::tool_operation_state, reconciliation_source = #{source}, reconciled_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid

UPDATE tool_operation SET state = 'MANUAL_DISPOSED', reconciliation_source = #{source}, manual_disposed_by = #{actorId}, manual_disposed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, operation_id::text, run_id::text, tool_name, idempotency_key, created_at FROM tool_operation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'UNKNOWN' ORDER BY created_at

SELECT o.tenant_id, o.operation_id::text, o.state::text, o.fencing_token, (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_operation_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND a.operation_id = o.operation_id) AS attempt_count FROM tool_operation o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND o.operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid
SELECT o.tenant_id, o.tool_name, o.tool_arguments::text, o.idempotency_key FROM tool_operation o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND o.operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid

SELECT o.tenant_id, o.operation_id::text, o.state::text, o.fencing_token, (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_operation_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND a.operation_id = o.operation_id) AS attempt_count FROM tool_operation o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND o.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_operation_attempt (tenant_id, operation_id, attempt_number, state, fencing_token, completed_at, error_class, error_message, result_unknown) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{operationId}::uuid, #{attemptNumber}, #{state}::tool_operation_state, #{fencingToken}, now(), #{errorClass}, #{errorMessage}, #{resultUnknown})
